description: This C# source file defines the 'TextFrame' class within the MigraDoc library, which models a customizable text frame that can hold paragraphs, charts, tables, and images. It includes methods for adding and cloning content, property accessors for margins and orientation, and serialization support.

classes.name: TextFrame
classes.description: Represents a floating text frame that can contain paragraphs, charts, tables, and images, with configurable margins and orientation.

classes.name: TextFrame.TextFrameValues
classes.description: Encapsulates internal nullable properties for the TextFrame's margins, orientation, and elements.

methods.name: TextFrame
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new TextFrame object, optionally with a parent DocumentObject.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this TextFrame instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the internal deep copy of the object, including cloning of nested elements.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph to the text frame.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph with specified text.

methods.name: AddChart
methods.description: Adds a new chart of specified type.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds a new image by filename.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds existing Paragraph, Chart, Table, or Image objects to the elements collection.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the TextFrame object into a serialized format (DDL).
